definitions: To leave a place for a short time.
To go out to a social event or to enjoy oneself.
To reveal oneself or come into public view.
To take a step outside of a vehicle.
To begin to walk quickly or with a long stride.
examples: I need to step out for a moment to take this call.
They like to step out on the weekends and try new restaurants.
The celebrity decided to step out and address the rumors.
Be careful when you step out of the car.
He began to step out briskly towards the finish line.
